messages.content: The airline just moved Tuesday's arrival 85 minutes later. Check the new timing against the rental reservation. I cannot risk arriving without a car before Wednesday's 8:00 a.m. start.

The revised SFO-RDU flight now arrives at 6:07 p.m. Tuesday. Your reserved compact is with the terminal agency whose counter closes at 6:45 p.m. The reservation gives no after-hours instructions, so I am checking whether they will hold the car and what later-closing airport option is available.
Please compare the cost before changing it.

The reserved rental is $286.40 through Friday morning. The agency confirmed that pickup must be completed by 6:45 p.m.; it will not leave keys or transfer the reservation after closing. With a 6:07 p.m. landing, reaching the counter in 38 minutes is not dependable. An alternate on-airport agency in the same rental center closes at 11:30 p.m. and has a compact for $312.18, including taxes and fees. The increase is $25.78.
Does the later agency require a shuttle, and what would the full trip total become?

No separate shuttle is required. You would use the terminal-to-rental-center bus serving all on-airport agencies. With the $742 airfare, $528.66 hotel, and $312.18 replacement rental, the updated trip total is $1,582.84 before fuel, meals, baggage, or optional coverage.
Switch the rental. Keep the Friday flight and hotel exactly as they are.

The original rental has been canceled without a fee. The compact is now reserved with the later-closing airport agency from Tuesday evening through Friday morning for $312.18, payable at pickup. Confirmation is NC4D81. The Friday 8:10 a.m. flight and hotel confirmation RDU6K83 are unchanged.
Give me the arrival sequence and Wednesday morning schedule in one final note.

Final schedule: Tuesday flight arrives RDU at 6:07 p.m. With no checked bag, allow about 20 minutes to exit and reach the rental-center bus, arrive at the counter around 6:35-6:45, complete pickup by roughly 7:05, and reach the hotel around 7:35 p.m. The counter remains open until 11:30 p.m. Wednesday: leave the hotel at 7:25 a.m. for the estimated 18-minute drive, arrive near 7:43, and allow 17 minutes for parking and entry before the 8:00 a.m. site start. Friday remains a 4:55 a.m. hotel departure for the rental return and 8:10 a.m. flight. Updated trip total: $1,582.84.
